line.issue: Since symfony/framework-bundle 6.4: Not setting the "framework.php_errors.log" config option is deprecated. It will default to "true" in 7.0.
Since 6.4 symfony/messenger: The "messenger.listener.stop_worker_signals_listener" service is deprecated, use the "Symfony\Component\Console\Command\SignalableCommandInterface" instead.

The "Zenstruck\Messenger\Test\Transport\TestTransport::get()" method will require a new "int $fetchSize" argument in the next major version of its interface "Symfony\Component\Messenger\Transport\Receiver\ReceiverInterface", not defining it is deprecated.
